Container.Name: Audiobind
Container.Overview: Finds audiobooks that are split into many files, checks each one against the Audible catalog, merges the parts into a single tagged m4b with real chapter marks and cover art, and files it into a clean Author/Title library. Runs on a timer and only converts books it is confident about.

Container.Description:
### What it does
Point Audiobind at a folder of audiobooks and a folder to write to. On a timer it:
1. **Groups parts into books** - `Book/Disc 1`, `Book/Part 2` and `Book/Part 10` become one book, not three. 2. **Verifies the book** against the Audible catalog: title, author, narrator, series, ASIN. 3. **Proves completeness** by comparing total runtime with the catalog runtime. A set that is an hour short is reported, not merged. 4. **Merges and converts**: one `.m4b`, AAC 64 kbps mono, real chapter marks from Audnex, cover art and full tags embedded. 5. **Files it** as `Author/Title/Title.m4b` (or `Author/Series/03 - Title/`), with an Audiobookshelf-compatible `metadata.json`.
### What it will not do
* It never deletes, moves or rewrites your source files. Input is mounted read-only. * It does not convert anything it is unsure about. Matches that are only partial, or whose runtime disagrees with the catalog by more than 25%, are marked **review**/**held** on the status page for you to look at.
Suitable for Audiobookshelf, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, Apple Books and anything else that reads standard m4b chapters and tags.

Config.Name: Library path
Config.Description: Folder holding the audiobooks to fix. Writable so Delete can fully remove a book. Owner decides: set Access Mode to Read Only for a guarantee the app never touches your sources - this disables source-delete (Delete then removes only the output).

Config.Name: Output path
Config.Description: Where finished m4b files are written. Never the same as the library path.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, audit report and work files.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Status page and JSON API.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated names/IPs you open the web UI with, e.g. 192.168.1.10,tower,tower.local. Any other address is refused (protects against DNS-rebinding attacks). Add your server's LAN IP here or the UI is only reachable from the server itself.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: Optional password for the web UI and API. Leave empty for no sign-in. Scripts send it as 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: true only when Audiobind sits behind your own reverse proxy: X-Forwarded-Host is then checked against Allowed hosts.

Config.Name: Auto convert
Config.Description: Which confidence tiers convert without asking: high, medium or off.

Config.Name: Scan interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to look for new books.

Config.Name: Audio bitrate (floor)
Config.Description: Minimum AAC bitrate. A richer source keeps its own bitrate (a 256k mp3 stays 256k); anything below this is lifted to it. Capped at 320k.

Config.Name: Channels
Config.Description: 1 = mono, 2 = stereo. Mono halves the file size.

Config.Name: Parallel jobs
Config.Description: Books converted at once. Raise if your CPU is idle.

Config.Name: Nice level
Config.Description: CPU priority for ffmpeg. Higher = yields to everything else.

Config.Name: Max runtime delta
Config.Description: Hold a book when its runtime differs from the catalog by more than this fraction (0.25 = 25%).

Config.Name: Region
Config.Description: Audible region for metadata: us, ca, uk, au, fr, de, it, es, jp, in.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = log every decision but write nothing.

Config.Name: Notify URL
Config.Description: Optional webhook (Discord/Slack/ntfy) posted a summary after each scan.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for written files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for written files.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps.
